answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The manifest lists a name once it holds Hammerbound melter forge warrant, and a warrant melters show after melting room trials is the entry the clerk looks for. Nobody is waved through free: 120 separate visits, each one billed £14 at the door is the price, and the atlas never covers it twice. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The tundra is on the docket. Every quill is counted once.
